steps.text: Stir graham cracker crumbs, brown sugar, and cinnamon together in a small bowl; add melted butter and mix well. Press into the bottom of a 10-inch springform pan. Chill in the refrigerator until firm.
Beat cream cheese and lemon juice together in a medium bowl until soft. Add whipping cream and beat with an electric mixer until batter is thick. Add sugar and continue to beat until stiff.
Pour into chilled crust and smooth the top. Cover with pie filling or fresh berries Chill in the refrigerator for 8 hours or overnight.
Just before serving, remove the sides of the springform pan.

raw_recipe.headline: Best No-Bake Cheesecake
raw_recipe.description: This no-bake cheesecake made with whipping cream and cream cheese comes together easily and sets beautifully without turning on your oven!

review.reviewBody: I thought this recipe was very easy to make. I didn't have any trouble getting it to get thick. I did make a couple of adjustments. I increased the sugar to 2/3 c. and added a little bit of vanilla. I love the graham cracker crust so I made it extra thick. I also make it in a 9" square pan. It was delicious!! For those who had trouble getting it thick, make sure that you have "heavy" whipping cream.

I thought that it had too much whipping cream and not enough cheese, so…I adjusted it and it came out perfectly. I can make a cheesecake in 10 minutes. First of all, I get an already made graham cracker pie crust. Then I take 1 & 1/2 packages of cream cheese from the fridge and soften it in the microwave for about a minute. Then I beat the cream cheese with a teaspoon of lemon and set it aside. Then I beat 3/4 cup whipping cream with 1/4 c. sugar in my Kitchen Aid mixer until it’s firm. Then I add the cream cheese mixture and mix them together until they are combined well (10-15 seconds. After that, I put in the pie pan, let it chill for about an hour, then put pie filling on top and voilà. Super fast, super yummy and not too sweet cheesecake! I’ve made this numerous times and EVERYONE loves it!

Fantastic recipe! Best cheese cake I’ve ever made. I did whip the whipping cream and sugar separately from the cream cheese and then beat it into the cream cheese. Light and fluffy texture while still being dense. Delicious!

i made this cheesecake last night and i can not wait for my family to try it! this is my first time making a no bake recipe and i thought it went very smoothly and quickly. i ended up adding another 1/3 cup of sugar and a splash of vanilla after i read through the other comments and tasted it myself. i think it really elevated the taste. i also ended up switching the cherry pie filling for raspberry pie because i’m not a big fan of cherry. also, i got pre done gram cracker crust (9 inch) in chocolate flavor at the store and didn’t even use all the filling so i made two and each was topped with a 12 oz can of filling. again, i cannot wait you try this new recipe. ????

Made this cake for the first time and I was happy with the result! I followed the recommendations to whip the cream separately and then fold it in the cream cheese mixture, and I think this really made it airy and fluffy. I didn’t add any extra sugar since I don’t really have a sweet tooth. It came out delicious. I let it sit overnight in the fridge. However, since I live in a tropical area, the cherry topping were starting to drip over the minute it came out the fridge. Since I love this recipe and I don’t want to add more cream cheese to hold it’s shape, to prevent it from melting next time I’ll freeze it at least 15mins before serving. 
Also, I recommend putting parchment paper at the bottom of the pan you use to remove it from the pan for serving. Even though I used a pan where the side were removable, cutting from the bottom of the pan made it break apart easily (the crust). Next time I won’t use cherry pie filling either, because it was just a bit too running for me (again because of tropics). I’ll probably use fresh berries and make my own topping. Or maybe even add the topping when serving.
Always whip up the heavy cream separately then fold into the cream cheese mixture. Doing it the way this recipe suggests runs the risk of it not thickening properly and ending up with a goopy mess
I didn't have graham crumbs so I used almond flour instead. I baked it at 350 for 10 minutes. Changed nothing else. This turned out delicious. Thanks for sharing the recipe.

I'd love to rate this a 4.5 stars. It's not quite as good as a baked but it IS quite delish for nobake. I am handicapped and standing is difficult so I took some short cuts. Everyone seemed pretty pleased with the pie. I followed a number of other reviewers suggestions: 
I whipped the Heavy Cream, with twice the sugar that the recipe calls for, until it peaked beautifully and set it aside. 
 I added a 3rd bar of room temp cream cheese and prepared the three and the lemon juice per instruction. This provided enough filling to make two pies in standard store bought graham cracker crusts. 
I chilled the pies for a couple of hours before topping one with a can of unsweetened cherries. By request, I'm making this again tonight.

I used others suggestions and whipped the cream first, added a little vanilla and then whipped the cream cheese seperately and 2/3 cup sugar and added the cream back in. topped it with homemade cherry pie filling from this site. very yummy! Will make again!

I've made this twice. I always chill heavy whipping cream in approx freezer 30 mins before whipping. I Only add whipped cream to cream cheese mixture tbsp by tbsp until it's just thick (not stiff ) enough to pour .. about 4-6tbsp less than recipe

This is the 2nd time I've made this cheese cake. The first time it went within 15 minutes of me making it! That made me feel good🤗! I'm making it again, but this time I added1/4 cup of sour cream and 1tsp of pure vanilla extract. I must admit it was quite tasty. Thank you for this simple, delicious recipe!
excellent
Read the reviews first. Whip the whipping cream first!!!
Loved it. Will cut the amount of cream next time in hopes of making it a bit firmer.
N/a
We LOVE this recipe! I do make some adjustments, tho. Instead of a graham cracker crust, I make an Oreo crust, then add some vanilla and chopped Oreos into the filling

I made this to use as a filling for muffins. I altered it slightly for what I had on hand...lime juice for lemon juice, 1/2 cup of powdered sugar instead of granulated sugar, and entire container of cool whip instead of heavy whipping cream (i added it in tbsp by tbsp since it was frozen). Refrigerated overnight and it came out great! Blueberry cream cheese muffins were wonderful and the leftover cheesecake made great dessert for another night too!
Way too much whipping crème, did not set. Also bland. Wish I would’ve read the comments prior to making.
No changes. It was great

I made this cheesecake for my son for his birthday. He took it to work, and only got one small piece because everyone raved about it! The office girls all wanted the recipe. Next time I made one, my neighbor came over and took half! I made another, and didn't tell anybody. Ate the whole thing myself! Not all at once, but oh my goodness! This cheesecake is pure deliciousness!
